memory: Baseline: 512MiB DDR3, two x16 devices, 32-bit bus; alternative memory studies retained but not selected.
external_ports: One USB-C:5V sink, RK3568 USB3 device/network and ROM programming/recovery
internal: Included non-touch color display on top face; removable internal connection preferred for assembly and service, not a separately sold optional accessory.
Internal 2x10 1.27mm header: SPI0, I2C2, UART1 and four GPIO; custom Phoenix pinout, no HAT compatibility.
Integrated Wi-Fi with external antenna; SDIO module candidate under electrical, sourcing and Linux AP-mode review.
not_requested: ROCK3A HDMI, audio, extra USB host or M.2 ports
expansion_constraints: Reserve power/current budget, ground returns and3.3V IO domain.
Do not claim Raspberry Pi HAT compatibility from mechanical pin count alone.
Select I2C/SPI/UART/GPIO only after checking display, boot, DDR, Ethernet and USB conflicts.
Do not route an RF stub or fit an antenna connector without a defined radio-side RF design.
cellular: 5G/eSIM exploratory only; excluded from current implementation

mechanical.status: User retained 90x40; 100x30 study cancelled before changing board.
mechanical.height_status: Unverified estimate; display, RJ45, heatsink and enclosure stack-up pending
mechanical.appearance_reference: User supplied Belkin Ethernet dongle image: elongated rounded enclosure, display on broad upper face where logo appears; detachable cable through existing USB-C receptacle. Reference image does not establish dimensions.
mechanical.cooling_target: Passive cooling through metal base/sides, thermally independent from display lid; not validated.
mechanical.cooling_evidence: review/passive-thermal-screen.json; hypothetical sensitivity only, no guaranteed fanless throughput

display.status: Display included in base product by user request; removable attachment implementation pending
display.proposed_architecture: Keep existing main-board LCD supply, buffer and backlight circuit; qualify removable panel connection. Separate display electronics board is not currently required.
display.installation: Install or remove with power disconnected; hot-plug operation is not designed.
display.base_device: Display included; web administration remains available.
display.expansion: Keep future expansion connector available; propose dedicated display connection using existing allocated LCD signals.
qualification_pending: Select exact connector and cable, verify JLCPCB availability and cost.
Current panel has 13 contacts at 0.7 mm pitch; do not assume compatibility with a standard 0.5 mm FFC connector. Qualify panel attachment or choose a suitable replacement.
Verify enclosure, display window, cable bend, heatsink clearance and thermal behavior.
